title: True Believers Giant-Size X-Men #1 Marvel 2017 Reprint 1st Storm Colossus
conditionDescription: Bright, clean covers; small chip on the right edge of the front cover near the barcode. See photos.
descriptionText:
True Believers: Giant-Size X-Men #1 (2017), Marvel Comics - $1 reprint of the 1975 Giant-Size X-Men #1, "Deadly Genesis!" Reprints the first appearances of Storm, Colossus, Nightcrawler and Thunderbird (new X-Men team). Len Wein and Dave Cockrum; classic Gil Kane / Dave Cockrum cover. $1.00 cover price.

Back cover: Marvel Epic Collection X-Men TPB ad.

Condition: bright, clean covers; small chip on the right edge of the front cover near the barcode (see close-up photo).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
